lines.speaker: Johan
lines.sv: Hur var helgen? Åkte du till stugan?
lines.en: How was the weekend? Did you go to the cabin?

lines.speaker: Elsa
lines.sv: Nej, det regnade mycket i lördags. Vi stannade hemma.
lines.en: No, it rained a lot on Saturday. We stayed at home.

lines.speaker: Johan
lines.sv: Och i söndags?
lines.en: And on Sunday?

lines.speaker: Elsa
lines.sv: I söndags gick vi på Vasamuseet med min kusin.
lines.en: On Sunday we went to the Vasa Museum with my cousin.

lines.speaker: Johan
lines.sv: Var det bra?

lines.speaker: Elsa
lines.sv: Ja, men det var mycket folk. Vi väntade i en timme.
lines.en: Yes, but there were a lot of people. We waited for an hour.

questions.question: What did Elsa do on Saturday?
questions.explanation: It rained, and she says: “Vi stannade hemma.”

questions.question: Who went to the museum with her?
questions.explanation: She went to the museum “med min kusin”.

questions.question: What was the problem at the museum?
choices: There were a lot of people.
questions.explanation: “det var mycket folk” means there were a lot of people.

questions.question: How long did they wait?
questions.explanation: “Vi väntade i en timme.”

gloss.en: the Vasa Museum (a museum in Stockholm)

lines.speaker: Personalen
lines.sv: Hej, vad har hänt?

lines.sv: Jag glömde min väska på tåget från Uppsala igår kväll.
lines.en: I left my bag on the train from Uppsala yesterday evening.

lines.sv: Vilken färg hade väskan?

lines.sv: Åkte du till sjukhuset?

lines.sv: Det var inte så smart!

passages.title: A note on the kitchen table

lines.sv: Mamma, katten kom in i köket i morse.
lines.en: Mum, the cat came into the kitchen this morning.

lines.sv: Den har slagit sönder vasen som stod på bordet.
lines.en: It has broken the vase that was on the table.

lines.sv: Jag har torkat golvet, men bitarna ligger i en påse.
lines.en: I have wiped the floor, but the pieces are in a bag.

lines.sv: Jag gick till skolan klockan åtta. Vi ses i kväll!

questions.question: What did the cat do?

questions.explanation: “Den har slagit sönder vasen”

questions.question: Where was the vase?
questions.explanation: “vasen som stod på bordet”

questions.question: What did the writer clean?
questions.explanation: “Jag har torkat golvet”

questions.question: What time did the writer leave?
questions.explanation: “Jag gick till skolan klockan åtta.”

lines.en: You look tired. What did you do at the weekend?

questions.question: How many friends helped him?

questions.question: When did they finish?

passages.title: Yesterday on the road to Gävle

lines.sv: Igår morse stoppade en olycka all trafik mellan Uppsala och Gävle.
lines.en: Yesterday morning an accident stopped all traffic between Uppsala and Gävle.

lines.sv: Bilisterna väntade i mer än två timmar i regnet.
lines.en: The drivers waited for more than two hours in the rain.

lines.sv: Polisen öppnade en annan väg vid elvatiden.

lines.sv: Ingen blev skadad, men tio bilar fick stå kvar på vägen.

questions.question: What was the weather like?

questions.question: Was anyone hurt?
